patterns.diagnosis: Vercel Deployment Protection blocks unauthenticated Preview access.
patterns.suggestedFix: Set VERCEL_PROTECTION_BYPASS secret in GitHub/VM, or use Vercel Share link. See docs/staging-vercel-preview-env.md.

patterns.diagnosis: API Preview deployment is missing DATABASE_URL (Neon test branch).
patterns.suggestedFix: Add DATABASE_URL to Vercel api project Preview env (postgresql+asyncpg://…). Redeploy staging. See docs/staging-vercel-preview-env.md.

patterns.diagnosis: Login endpoint failed — often env (JWT_SECRET, PROTOTYPE_BOOTSTRAP_PASSWORD) or missing seed data.
patterns.suggestedFix: Verify Preview env vars on api project; run bootstrap on Neon test branch.

patterns.diagnosis: API reachable but Neon test branch lacks seed/demo tickets.
patterns.suggestedFix: Run bash scripts/bootstrap-dev-database.sh against Neon test (never main).

patterns.diagnosis: Deployment not ready or build still propagating.
patterns.suggestedFix: Wait for Vercel deployment READY; check Vercel build logs for failed build.

patterns.diagnosis: Vercel build failed — CI may be green while deploy breaks.
patterns.suggestedFix: Inspect Vercel deployment logs; reproduce with cd apps/web && npm run build or apps/api deploy.

patterns.diagnosis: Staging Preview reports production identity — wrong STARDESK_ENV on Preview.
patterns.suggestedFix: Set STARDESK_ENV=test on api Preview; NEXT_PUBLIC_STARDESK_ENV=test on web Preview.

patterns.diagnosis: FRONTEND_URL on API does not match staging web URL.
patterns.suggestedFix: Set FRONTEND_URL to staging web Preview URL on api Preview env.

checkDefinitions.description: Poll Vercel until api+web deployments are READY
